item.title: NIST Demonstrates 100x SNSPD Width Scaling to Unblock Quantum Network and Photonic Manufacturing Bottlenecks
item.summary: Physicists at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) have developed a magnetic shielding architecture that scales the physical width of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) up to 0.1 mm (100 µm)—100 times wider than standard nanoscale SNSPDs and 20 times wider than previous state-of-the-art implementations. Published in Optica, the design uses active current [...] The post NIST Demonstrates 100x SNSPD Width Scaling to Unblock Quantum Network and Photonic Manufacturing Bottlenecks appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
